text:
Alex: Heads-up — planning to deploy console-frontend frontend@2026.03.17-rc2 at 16:30 PT (23:30 UTC). 15m window. Canary -> 10% -> 100% if green. Need CDN invalidation + smoke checks. Who can trigger CDN?
Maria: I can handle CDN. Will invalidate /static/console/* and /assets/console/* after canary passes. Any non-cacheable routes to include?
Kevin: I'll kick off the canary at 16:30. I'll tag the release: frontend@2026.03.17-rc2. Watch Datadog dashboard `console.frontend.deploys`.
devops-bot: Deployment started by Kevin — build 8843 -> canary 10%.
Alex: Quick smoke checklist (run after canary lands):
- home load < 400ms
- login flow OK (POST /api/auth)
- settings save OK (PUT /api/users/*/settings)
- feature-flagged widget visible when feature_flag=on
Example curl checks:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://console.redwood.ai/
curl -s -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/auth -d '{"user":"smoke"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```
Jordan: I'll run the curl scripts and scan Sentry for new errors. Pinging ui-sre to watch cache headers and CDN edge behavior.
ui-sre: Noted. CDN invalidation path: /static/console/**, purge by surrogate-key: console-v2. Plan: set edge cache-control for html to `public, max-age=60` during rollout, longer for static assets. Also watch `x-cache` headers.
Maria: Invalidation command ready (Cloudflare):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/<zone>/purge_cache" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CF_API" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"files":["https://console.redwood.ai/static/console/*","https://console.redwood.ai/assets/console/*"]}'
```
I'll run this after canary -> 100% or earlier if we need to flush.
Kevin: Canary looks clean at 5m (no 5xx, latency stable). Moving to 50% then will watch for 10m.
devops-bot: Canary -> 50% completed.
Alex: Rollback criteria: >0.5% error spike or key flow failure (login/settings). Rollback steps: 1) pause rollout, 2) revert canary routing to previous tag (frontend@2026.03.16-prod123), 3) re-purge CDN to console-v1 surrogate-key, 4) notify customers if needed. Who will execute rollback?
Kevin: I can rollback if needed. Keep me posted in this thread. Previous tag for quick revert: frontend@2026.03.16-prod123.
Jordan: :thumbsup: warming cache now — hitting top 10 routes with small loops (home, login, dashboard, /assets). Will report response times.
Alex: Thanks team. I'll update when we hit 100%. Leave this thread open for any rollback triggers or post-deploy notes.
